svg.text: Wires with the same coloured label are connected. Pin numbers are physical header pins; GPIO numbers are BCM. See wiring.md for details and tests.
Dashed box: pins 1–26 are under the DV3000 — reach them
through a 40-pin GPIO splitter or a tall stacking header.
Status LED: red = TX, green = RX,
Mode LEDs: green = RX on, red = TX mode,
yellow = both, blue = call on air
Optional PTT jack: tip → GPIO23, sleeve → GND
